extension.description: Use DeepSeek Harness from the VS Code sidebar.
view.title: DeepSeek Harness
configuration.title: DeepSeek Harness
configuration.host.basePort: First loopback port to probe; up to ten consecutive ports are checked.
configuration.host.autoStart: Start a local DeepSeek Harness host if no compatible host is already running.
configuration.host.executable: Optional absolute path or PATH command name for the dsh executable.
configuration.host.arguments: Arguments inserted after the configured executable and before the dsh web command. Shell command strings are not supported.
configuration.host.keepAliveOnExit: Keep a host started by this extension alive after the last VS Code window closes.
configuration.ideContext.enabled: Attach editor context to normal messages. Slash commands never receive automatic IDE context.
configuration.ideContext.ephemeral.enabl: Experimental: use the local IDE Bridge and per-turn ephemeral context when the DSH IDE Context Runtime plugin is available. Falls back silently when unavailable.
configuration.notifications.onCompletion: Show a notification when a background session completes.
